items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Schirmer in the context of an auction item intended for Chauncey Morehouse, but Chauncey does not speak or describe a personal relationship with Schirmer.

ctx.x: Yes, I bid on it but I didn't bid enough to get it. I was going to give it to Chauncey. That's one of the reasons.
